## Professional Summary

İbrahim Halil Sezgin is a Full-Stack Developer with expertise in building end-to-end web applications, real-time automation systems, and scalable REST APIs. He focuses on event-driven architectures, workflow automation, and modern backend development using Node.js and TypeScript.

## Work Experience

### Jetconnect — Full-Stack Developer (2024–Present)
Building web applications and services at Jetconnect. Working with event-driven architectures, workflow automation using n8n and Apify, and developing modern backends with Node.js and TypeScript.

### wBox.me — Founder & Developer (2023–Present)
Founded and built wBox.me, a high-performance WhatsApp SaaS and API automation platform. The platform provides real-time messaging, bot automation, and API integration services for businesses. Built with Node.js, WebSockets, and MongoDB.

### Freelance — Full-Stack Developer (2022–2023)
Developed custom web applications and APIs for various clients. Full-stack development with JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem.
